diagnosedConstructionCause: The hoodie torso is the exact muscular body chart plus 24mm normal offset and small sign-based ease. Parallel offsets preserve pectoral and abdominal concavities and even emphasize their ridges. Material detail cannot remove this inherited silhouette.

recommendedNextUnit.construction: Fit smooth enclosing torso cross-sections to the connected central body surface, excluding disconnected arms. Loft a single convex/oval chest and waist envelope. Deliberate waist/hem ease fills the abdominal and sternum concavities, instead of following each muscle.

recommendedNextUnit.transition: Blend the shell displacement smoothly into the pinned shoulder/armhole/neck/cuff boundaries across local source mesh rows. Keep the lower hem regular and give the torso modest fullness above its rib band.
recommendedNextUnit.drape: Add only a few broad, shallow folds caused by hem gathering and arm reach. No pectoral, abdominal or random high-frequency sculpted folds.
recommendedNextUnit.pocket: Reproject the kangaroo pocket onto the new cloth shell, with recognizable entry seams; its current body-front projection would become buried by fuller cloth.
recommendedNextUnit.shading: Recompute geometric garment normals after the shell change. A small optional baked fabric normal map can supplement broad shape; do not import donor baked lighting as body shading.
recommendedNextUnit.budget: One candidate, one native build and one matched whole-clothed played Garage/game review. No radius/normal/weight sweep. Retain prior boundary failures and actual03/04 verdict.
recommendedNextUnit.staticAdmission: The shell must enclose the untouched body in rest with declared garment ease, preserve source chart connectivity and boundary loop fields, remain below the current provisional actor and texture allocations, and keep native/export transport checks meaningful.
recommendedNextUnit.movingAdmission: Parent must play generic reach/crouch and actual forward/back bike motion. Judge a natural hoodie volume with no muscle tracing, skin pokes, jagged boundaries, shoulder collapse or pocket burial. Static enclosure is not an all-pose pass.
